legacy_metric.semantics: count of overlapping analysis windows whose median raw-channel RMS exceeds the frozen signal threshold divided by inspected seconds
legacy_metric.retention: preserve every existing result and relabel without deletion

legacy_distinct_event_rate.reason: existing S4.3 data were inspected before this de-duplicated detector was frozen

prospective_metric.event_semantics: one bounded, multi-channel, de-duplicated RMS-envelope excursion classified as transient rather than short, stationary, or boundary-censored
prospective_metric.denominator: complete inspected intended-silence interval duration in seconds
prospective_metric.aggregation: event count, rate, durations, peak samples, stationary/short/boundary diagnostic counts
prospective_metric.applicability: only the prospectively frozen new intended-silence trial
prospective_metric.limitations: functional digital room-fixture-sensor characterization; not SPL, microphone self-noise, or a population event rate

detector.input_channels: all four declared raw analysis channels
detector.separation_and_deduplication: bridge each bounded inactive gap no longer than 1600 samples once, then count each connected qualifying excursion once

stopping_rule: one terminal attempt completes the corrective cell; a failed attempt remains retained and leaves prospective event-rate coverage unavailable absent a separately authorized prospective failure-handling record
